# Rakshith Bangalore

> Robotics engineer and entrepreneur working between the United Kingdom and Singapore. Builds intelligence into machines: humanoid robots (Unitree H1-2 and G1 on a PepsiCo programme), Industry 4.0 mobile manipulation, medical robotics, and AI products — with software project management (JIRA, Confluence, Miro) and hardware product management (BOM, DFM, US market entry). Hosts Unfiltered Robotics, a podcast on legged robots and hardware development.

Facts:
- Professional humanoid R&D: neural policies for legged control, sim-to-real transfer and actuator identification on Unitree H1-2 and G1.
- Industry 4.0 mobile manipulator (award-winning MEng capstone): UR-10 arm on an Omron LD250 base with SmartShift tool changing, scoped with Walkers around a live factory workflow.
- Laparoscopic surgery trainer: compliant force-feedback mechanism, eight-month build with an NHS Trust.
- Aircraft cabin lab: a decommissioned Embraer ERJ 145 turned into a flight-comfort research platform (EU Clean Sky 2, Comfdemo).
- Product work: PodCut, an AI post-production SaaS (pilot post-production down from 4 days to 4 hours), and GoBox, a portable studio moving to its first production run.
- Education: MEng, Nottingham Trent University.
